shared_elements: incised linear designs on a flat stone surface
rows of small repeated sign-like marks (script-like or schematic signs)
framing lines or bands along the edges
justification: Both surfaces are covered with shallow incised geometric linework including a prominent circle/disc and rows of small repeated linear signs arranged in bands, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with a head, headdress, arms, face and belt-like bands wrapping a body, while B is a flat panel whose design is an abstract framed rectangle with a wheel/cross-in-circle on a stem and marginal sign rows; no figural or relational scheme is shared.
